question: How accurately can the two installed heads move the visible liquid from a measured initial position to a specified destination, and how does the timing of motor rest change delivery?
fluid: Undiluted SodaStream Diet Cola concentrate in the same graduated cup and dish. A drains the cup and B returns syrup.
controller: Installed production firmware, bounded full-drive commands over USB serial.

historical_predictor.signed_cup_change: On-time in seconds times the head-specific rate, negative on A and positive on B. Add this to the starting observation to forecast the settled endpoint. Fixed from the two earliest sharp duration recordings.

fixed_width_pause_test.design: Interleave heads and rearrange conditions over separate blocks. Hold on-time and pulse count fixed. The additive prediction equals the single-gate rate times total on-time; compare the on-camera differences across pauses on each head. Use actual command and completion times.

endpoint_task.prediction: Write the measured starting position, requested target, chosen motor time and predicted endpoint to the trial log before sending a motor command. Score the first settled endpoint separately from any subsequent camera-guided correction.
endpoint_task.primary_error: signed distance to requested position and absolute error; report empirical median, maximum and distribution by head, with an independent sightline assessment. Use pixels as the primary position unit if absolute scales differ.
endpoint_task.blind_evaluation: Freeze the controller coefficients on training moves before opening a different ordered set of destination levels for validation. Report all attempted endpoints and unresolved outcomes.

controlled_variation: inter-pulse pause at fixed pulse width and count
settling and drift during pump-off periods
instrumentation: Hold the same focus, tone and exposure within a comparison. Save camera observations and timestamps and board acknowledgements. The kitchen cup provides nominal volume anchors. Scale and hose-supported load are excluded.
acceptance_for_running: Use a fresh live frame, validate features in separate parts of the glass, and stay within the observed operating band. Terminate a series on an unreadable level, wrong direction or missing acknowledgement.
